title: Mirabel and the Terminal
author: Zephyrine Sterling
blurb: Wendell Brightwater, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
